0022600005.text: Both the Lakers and Warriors open their 2026-27 seasons, with Los Angeles hosting Golden State in this regular-season game. Golden State will be without Jimmy Butler III and Moses Moody, who are both out after knee surgery, while Kristaps Porzingis is day-to-day for an undisclosed reason and a game-time decision. The Lakers won the 2025-26 season series 3-1, including a 119-103 win in San Francisco on April 9, 2026, and ESPN's matchup predictor gives Los Angeles a 65% chance to win.
